UpdateFoundQueue holds WithFileLock on the task file; WriteFoundQueue documents that the caller holds the lock and writes through writeFileAtomic (CreateTemp 0600, then rename). Parse errors are wrapped with %w.

FoundRunningUnits reads a failed probe as 'no unit runs': a non-ENOENT ReadRunState error (corrupt state) or any RunLockHeld error drops the main-tree units. That fold suits a reporting reader (runstate.go:430-431), not this guard: a false 'not running' lets apply reopen a wip finder a live unit holds, the round-4 7/11 case. RunLockHeld returns these errors so the caller does not fold them (runlock.go:74-77).
